body: A wound around belonging: the pain of being the outsider, too different to fit yet wanting to.
business: You become a champion for the excluded and a bridge for those who do not fit.
shadow: Self-isolating in advance, or forcing a belonging that costs your difference.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
